description: The overlay primitive. Any surface that covers content and takes the user's whole attention routes through it, so the four things a modal owes are implemented once: a focus trap, a background excluded from every modality, focus restored to the trigger, and a dismiss control that assistive technology can find.

MUST: Trap focus for its lifetime: Tab and Shift+Tab cycle within the layer and never reach the background.
Exclude the background from focus, pointer AND semantics together while open. Excluding one and not the others leaves the overlay reachable by the modality that was missed.
Move focus into the surface when it opens, and expose the surface as a dialog with an accessible name.
Restore focus to the element that opened it on dismiss, when that element is still in the document.
Capture the trigger before excluding the background — exclusion blurs whatever had focus, so reading it afterwards reads nothing.
Provide a dismiss barrier that is a labelled control exposed to assistive technology.
Leave the background exactly as it was found on dismiss: no residual exclusion, no residual pointer or semantic overrides.
Let the composing surface own its own position and motion, so entry, gesture and exit have a single driver.
SHOULD: Restore focus without scrolling the page to it.
Place the barrier so the surface's own content is traversed before the dismiss control — the exit is the last stop, not the first thing between the user and the surface.
NEVER: Use a bare element with a pointer handler as the barrier. A barrier that is only a gesture target is invisible to assistive technology, which turns every modal into a trap with no announced exit.
Rely on hiding from semantics alone where the platform can exclude focus and pointer as well.
Trap focus without a way out that is both visible and announced.
Claim an edge swipe for dismissal — edge gestures belong to the system.
Restore focus to an element that has left the document.
Nest a modal inside a modal. One primary subject at a time is the rule the whole language rests on.

notes: Verify a trap by behaviour, not by attribute. An inert ancestor leaves its descendants reporting that they are not inert while they are genuinely unreachable, so an attribute check reads as a false negative.
Modal does not manage its own presence. A surface that animates out must outlive its own open state, so the consumer decides when Modal is mounted; Modal arms on mount and restores on unmount.
